svg.title: role-arc-ring-four-colour-names-circled-steps
svg.desc: ring of four thick curved arcs in teal, red-brown, green and gold, each with its role name set along the arc (Perceiver, Planner MCTS with a small search tree on it, Executor, Evaluator with its metric names) and a circled step number 1 to 4, with a dashed curve at each corner and a small robot and speech bubble under the gold arc | source: icml26-0069_fig1 (icml26-0069_fig1_p2_mixed.svg) | candidate wave3:role-arc-ring-four-colour-names-circled-steps | units: pt at print size | colours as drawn, recolour by role
